name: Crash Champions
desc: Founder-led US collision repair group operating 650+ body shops across 39 states, repairing insured vehicles for drivers and insurers.
products: collision repair, auto body and paint, ADAS calibration (Automotive Technology Experts)
customers: drivers; auto insurers incl. GEICO and Allstate named as programme partners
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own CMO on its executive team page
stores_or_sites: more than 650+ locations in 39 states and DC
markets: United States, 39 states and the District of Columbia
qualifying_metric: Route C: 650+ locations; ranked third-largest US collision repair operator; named insurer partners

alt_indicators.evidence: third-largest operator of high-quality collision repair service in the U.S. (2026)
joint programmes with GEICO and Allstate (Oct and Aug 2026 releases)

signals.what: Expands to Rhode Island, acquires AutoPaint RI
Opens first Holland repair center, Ohio footprint to 27 locations
Annual Champions For a Cause campaign (Susan G. Komen), raised $45,000

fit_rationale: Acquisitive collision-repair roll-up with a CMO, insurer partners to entertain at US races (Miami, Austin, Las Vegas) and a car-owner audience; predecessor Service King title-sponsored a NASCAR race in 2017.
outstanding: Revenue not published; Clearlake stake size; employee count

name: Quick Quack Car Wash
desc: Founder-run express conveyor car wash chain with about 340 sites across eight western and southern US states, KKR-backed since 2024.
products: express exterior car washes, unlimited wash memberships, commercial fleet accounts
customers: car owners, membership subscribers, commercial fleets
marketing_autonomy_basis: Standalone company with own CEO and Chief Experience Officer
markets: Utah, Texas, Colorado, Arizona, California, Oklahoma, Nevada and Washington
qualifying_metric: Route C: 340 sites + ranked 4th-largest US car wash chain + 2,000+ employees; KKR $850M stake

alt_indicators.evidence: Professional Carwashing & Detailing ranked it fourth-largest US car wash chain in 2025

signals.what: Expanded into Nevada and Washington (four locations each)
Acquired Take 5 car wash locations in Utah (per reference title)

fit_rationale: Membership-driven car-care brand whose growth depends on recruiting subscribers in Sunbelt states; F1's growing US car-owner fanbase and Austin and Las Vegas races suit consumer activation and member promotions.
outstanding: Revenue; current site count; marketing head

name: Sweetwater
desc: Largely online US retailer of musical instruments and professional audio gear, majority-owned by Providence Equity, with USD 1.86bn 2025 revenue.
products: guitars, keyboards, recording and live-sound equipment, software, sales-engineer advice

signals.what: Revenue topped $1.8 billion after 'a string of 2025 successes' (Journal Gazette, 21 Jan 2026)

fit_rationale: Fast-growing USD 1.9bn music-gear e-tailer whose customers skew to the young male, tech-minded audience F1 is winning in the US; consumer promotions and content around US races.
outstanding: Marketing head; own site refused fetch (403)

name: Guitar Center
desc: Largest US musical instrument retailer with 304 stores and the Musician's Friend e-commerce brand, controlled by Ares Management.
products: instruments, pro audio, lessons, rentals, repairs

fin.value_orig: about $800 million debt reduction in Chapter 11 (2020); up to $165 million new equity

qualifying_metric: revenue (year not stated); also Route C: 304 stores + 10,000 employees
distress: Chapter 11 in Nov 2020, emerged Dec 2020; historically heavy debt
fit_rationale: National retail footprint of 304 stores lets it run in-store promotions and content around US Grands Prix; music and F1 share a lifestyle audience, but leverage after 2020 restructuring limits budget.
outstanding: Revenue year; current leverage; marketing head; no dated 2025-26 events found

name: Music Tribe
desc: Founder-owned holding group behind Behringer, Midas, Tannoy and nine other audio brands, manufacturing in its own Zhongshan, China complex.
products: mixing consoles, loudspeakers, microphones, synthesizers, amplifiers, audio chips (Coolaudio)
customers: musicians, live-sound and installation companies, retailers
stores_or_sites: Zhongshan manufacturing complex (built for up to 10,000 workers)
markets: Global distribution; HQ Philippines, manufacturing China, UK brand bases (Turbosound)
qualifying_metric: Route C: 3,000+ factory employees; own plant and operations in 3+ countries with 12 brands

alt_indicators.evidence: HQ Makati Philippines; manufacturing Zhongshan China; Turbosound based in UK

fit_rationale: Twelve-brand audio group selling worldwide through retailers; F1's fan festivals and concerts at races (Las Vegas, Abu Dhabi) are a showcase for Midas and Tannoy live-sound gear and a reach play for Behringer.
outstanding: Revenue; employee figure is from 2018; musictribe.com now redirects to another domain (rebrand unclear)

name: Rover
desc: Online marketplace matching pet owners with sitters and dog walkers in the US and Western Europe, taken private by Blackstone for USD 2.3bn.
products: pet sitting, boarding, dog walking, drop-in visits booked via app
marketing_autonomy_basis: Standalone portfolio company with own CEO
markets: United States and Western Europe (UK via Cat in a Flat; Spain via Gudog)

signals.what: CEO Aaron Easterly steps down after 14 years; Brent Turner named successor
International expansion through purchase of a dog-sitting platform (Gudog listed as subsidiary)

fit_rationale: App-based consumer brand expanding across the US and Europe, both core F1 markets; needs mass awareness among affluent pet owners, which F1 digital and broadcast reach could deliver.
f1_markets: United States, UK, Spain, Western Europe

name: Erwin Hymer Group
desc: Europe's leading motorhome and caravan group (Hymer, Dethleffs, Bürstner and ten more brands), wholly owned by NYSE-listed Thor Industries.
products: motorhomes, caravans, camper vans, rental (McRent), accessories (Movera)
customers: leisure travellers via dealer networks; rental customers
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own SE with management board and its own brand portfolio
stores_or_sites: plants in Germany (six sites), France, Italy, Poland
markets: Europe-wide through dealers and service companies, global distribution partners

fin.value_orig: EUR 2.1 bn announced (final price EUR 170m lower)

fit_rationale: USD 3.3bn European leisure-vehicle group whose buyers are affluent car-loving travellers; dealer hospitality at European races and campsite fan activations fit its customer base.
f1_markets: Germany-adjacent European races: Austria, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Hungary, UK

access.roles: CEO (chair of management board); brand managing directors

name: Hobby-Wohnwagenwerk
desc: Family-run German caravan and motorhome maker (Hobby, Fendt-Caravan) holding nearly 25% of the German and 15% of the European caravan market.
products: caravans (up to 13,000 a year), motorhomes (up to 3,500 a year)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Independent GmbH led by founder Harald Striewski
stores_or_sites: Fockbek plant (270,000 m2); Fendt-Caravan plant Mertingen
fit_rationale: Market-leading caravan brand in Germany and Europe, owner-led; European race weekends with large camping crowds (Spa, Zandvoort, Spielberg) suit dealer and consumer activation.
outstanding: Ownership detail beyond founder-led GmbH; article flagged as weakly sourced; budget likely modest

name: Sunseeker
desc: British builder of luxury motor yachts and superyachts, sold by Dalian Wanda to Lionheart Capital and Orienta Capital Partners in 2024.
products: performance motor yachts, Manhattan and superyacht ranges
customers: high-net-worth yacht owners via dealer network
parent_ultimate: Lionheart Capital and Orienta Capital Partners
stores_or_sites: Poole shipyard; c.117 sales/dealer office entries worldwide
markets: Dealers across Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa
qualifying_metric: Route C: c.2,600 employees + dealer/sales presence in many countries on all continents

alt_indicators.evidence: dealer/office list spans Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa

signals.what: Manhattan 94 global debut at Cannes Yachting Festival; 45M superyacht revealed (dates not shown on page)

fit_rationale: Luxury yacht buyers are exactly the guests at Monaco, Miami, Abu Dhabi and Las Vegas; new owners since late 2024 may want to reposition the brand after the Wanda years.
f1_markets: Monaco, Miami, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Italy, Spain, UK
compliance: Fined £358,760 in Nov 2024 for illegal teak imports from Myanmar
outstanding: Current revenue and headcount; new-owner deal value
